definition: A manually validated reusable recovery pattern defines a recurrence opportunity; occurrence 2 is a possible retrieval/reuse opportunity after occurrence 1.
selection_basis: Membership is determined only by the pre-treatment manually validated recurrence-family annotations and acquisition-to-transfer chronology. It does not depend on advice, retrieval, applicability checks, or observed B0/T outcomes.
